narration: Welcome to the Manuscripts gallery. This is the Illustrated Bhagavata Purana folio, accession number NM 77.1/3, a fine example of the Pahari school from around 1780 CE, crafted in the hills of Himachal Pradesh. It is a single page of opaque watercolour on paper, measuring 26 by 36 centimeters, depicting a scene from Krishna’s childhood with Devanagari text below, a format that was popular in royal courts for both devotion and education. The artist’s delicate brushwork brings the story to life, allowing viewers to follow the narrative through both image and script side by side. This folio was acquired by the National Museum for its Manuscripts collection, and it remains a treasured piece of India’s cultural heritage.
